title: Account Strategist, Google Customer Solutions
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with stakeholder management, business, sales industry or customer engagement.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Knowledge of the local market with excellent investigative skills.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy and tactics, and products across all digital advertising.
* Ability to lead and manage multiple projects with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to think about issues and develop recommendations and action plans.


**About The Job**
 Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleledadvertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
   

  

 In this role, you will work with the advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen relationships. You will drive product adoption and business growth. You will anticipate how decisions are made at C\-Level and you will explore and uncover the business needs of customers, and understand how the range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users.Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small\- and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage a portfolio of customers alongside account managers to deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering a quality sales experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and serve as a trusted consultant to optimize and expand their advertising investment by understanding business drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks and creating multi\-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, partnerships, business planning and strategy, review, and education for customers.
* Coach peers in the organization to create skill lift that drives customer growth and contributes to team success.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enable customer growth.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Sr. Implementation Consultant - CCAAS (AMER shift)
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Shift Timing:** 
 6 PM IST to 3 AM IST
   

  

 The
 **Senior CCaaS Implementation Consultant** 
 leads strategic implementation initiatives, ensuring Sprinklr customers receive exceptional onboarding, configuration, and long\-term platform value. This role blends deep technical proficiency with business acumen and leadership, guiding cross\-functional teams, mentoring peers, and acting as a senior escalation and consulting partner to enterprise clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of Sprinklr's CCaaS solutions for complex enterprise clients across diverse industries, ensuring scalability, performance, and long\-term value.
* Define implementation strategy and solution architecture aligned with customer goals, industry standards, and best practices.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, promoting excellence in configuration, client communication, and delivery methodologies.
* Own customer engagements as the primary senior point of contact, driving platform adoption, customer satisfaction, and solution alignment.
* Proactively identify potential risks, technical challenges, and optimization opportunities, implementing solutions that preempt issues and maximize client ROI.
* Conduct advanced health checks and audits for key customers; design remediation and enhancement plans to improve platform performance and adoption.
* Lead client discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and strategic planning for roadmap alignment and value realization.
* Drive stakeholder alignment across product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure seamless implementation and post\-go\-live support.
* Deliver expert\-level consultation on Sprinklr capabilities, integrations, and CCaaS best practices.
* Establish trusted advisor relationships with customer champions and executive stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in deploying Voice and Non\-Voice Contact Center applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral, or similar platforms.
* Proven track record in leading complex implementation projects, preferably in CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS environments.
* Deep understanding of voice technologies, protocols (TCP/IP, VOIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC), and contact center infrastructure (ACD, IVR, CTI, Dialer, SBC).
* Proficiency in platform configuration, system architecture, API integrations, and VoIP troubleshooting tools (e.g., Wireshark).
* Experience integrating with CRMs like Salesforce Service Cloud and other customer engagement platforms.
* Development experience with Groovy, JavaScript, and/or scripting for integrations is a plus.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and client\-facing communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Business proficiency in Korean and English is mandatory.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You’re a strategic advisor to clients and internal teams, driving measurable impact and platform maturity.
* You create repeatable frameworks and tools that improve team efficiency and customer outcomes.
* You proactively elevate the implementation practice by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and fostering innovation.
* You maintain a customer\-first mindset, consistently exceeding expectations in high\-pressure environments.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

 Vitto The Italia is an Indian frozen food manufacturer specializing in ready\-to\-eat frozen burger patties, pizzas, and prepared snacks. The company maintains a strict focus on customer satisfaction, competitive pricing, and reliable service. Vitto The Italia operates its own warehouse and packaging facility to ensure safe storage and premium\-quality packaging for every product.

The Sales Consultant will also collaborate with internal teams on promotions, inventory planning, and market intelligence to support overall business growth.

* Must have 2\-3 years of core experience in frozen snack category

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance, create value and accelerate results. Founded in 1983, A\&M is recognized for its entrepreneurial, action\-oriented culture and hands\-on approach to client problems. Its professionals work as independent thinkers and operators, combining practical execution with deep advisory expertise across industries and geographies. A\&M’s Global Capability Center in India, established in 2023, partners with business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC to deliver end\-to\-end client work, not only back\-office support. The rapidly growing center brings together consulting and industry professionals across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources and Financial Services. Guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity, A\&M focuses on leadership, action and results while creating measurable value for clients and stakeholders.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in GDN Advisory, you will lead consulting workstreams that help organizations design, launch and optimize Global Business Services and Global Capability Center models. You will translate strategic priorities into practical operating models, business cases, transition plans and transformation roadmaps that improve service quality, efficiency and enterprise value. Working with A\&M leaders, client executives and cross\-functional teams, you will own analysis, solution design and client\-ready deliverables across global markets and industries. The role combines structured problem solving with hands\-on implementation, requiring confidence in senior stakeholder discussions and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. You will also strengthen the practice through mentoring, proposal development and reusable GCC/GBS frameworks.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead GCC and GBS strategy and setup or expansion workstreams, converting client objectives into business cases, target operating models, governance structures and implementation priorities.
* Design TOMs, service delivery frameworks, SLAs and performance metrics that clarify accountability, improve service quality and enable measurable operating performance.
* Conduct location strategy, benchmarking, feasibility and cost\-benefit analyses using market, workforce and financial evidence to support defensible investment decisions.
* Manage transition and implementation planning, including milestones, risks, dependencies, change actions and adoption levers that move recommendations into sustained execution.
* Build financial models, process maps and analytical views that identify efficiency, automation and service excellence opportunities across corporate functions.
* Partner with client executives, A\&M leaders and cross\-functional teams to shape solutions, facilitate discussions and deliver clear, high\-quality outputs aligned to strategic priorities.
* Mentor Associates and Analysts while contributing to proposals, pitches, thought leadership and reusable GCC/GBS playbooks that expand team capability and business development impact.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Demonstrated expertise in GBS, GCC or shared services setup, expansion or optimization, with strong understanding of operating model design, process transformation and transition execution.
* Proven ability to develop business cases, financial models, feasibility studies, investment cases and cost\-benefit analyses that support senior client decisions.
* Strong proficiency in Excel modelling, PowerPoint and structured data analysis, with the ability to convert complex findings into concise, client\-ready recommendations.
* Experience with TOM design, benchmarking, governance frameworks, SLAs, performance metrics and service delivery models across corporate functions or global operating environments.
* Familiarity with digital enablement, intelligent automation, analytics solutions or technology\-led transformation, including how these levers improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting independently with senior client executives and leading workstream discussions.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant* 
***post MBA***
*experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands\-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high\-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem\-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Senior Associate will own high\-impact workstreams for Energy\-sector clients, combining deep sub\-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O\&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub\-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client\-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time\-sensitive engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
* Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem\-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value\-creation opportunities.
* Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
* Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
* Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy\-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
* Adapt across adjacent Energy sub\-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub\-sector, such as O\&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
* Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
* Advanced problem\-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
* Exposure to multiple Energy sub\-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
* Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
* A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
* Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub\-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O\&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
* A record of owning analytical and problem\-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
* The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
* A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast\-paced, high\-expectation environments.
* Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands\-on delivery.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on consequential Energy\-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
* Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub\-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
* Join a performance\-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
* Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy\-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.



  





**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to work on high\-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
* A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross\-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
* A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

title: Account Director, Large Enterprise
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long\-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
   

  

 In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value\-driven strategy.
   

  

 You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.
   

  

 This role will be based in Delhi.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a small number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.
* Manage consumption revenue forecasts.
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.
* Support the development of company culture.


**We're Seeking Someone With Experience In**
* 10\+ years selling platform\-as\-a\-service and/or software\-as\-a\-service.
* Achieving revenue targets \>$2M per year for more than 3 years.
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies.
* Supporting the growth of fast\-growing, high\-performance companies.
* Working directly with c\-level executives.
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leading high\-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are customer\-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.


**About OpenAI**
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Regional Growth Leaders
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Metafusion is a Unified Video Intelligence Platform provider. A platform that that integrates big video data, Natural Language Processing, computer vision, and Generative AI to unlock the full potential of metadata. Its advanced AI powered video analytics engine enables customers to derive actionable insights through natural language search, visual data interpretation, and on\-the\-fly content generation. This unified platform transforms how users explore and interact with large video data repositories, driving informed decision\-making and innovation. Metafusion’s solutions support a wide range of industries, including Smart and Safe Cities, Surveillance, Traffic and Transportation, Warehousing and Logistics, Hospitality and Healthcare, Banking, and Retail.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 Growth Leader is Metafusion's revenue engine on the ground — a dual\-mandate leader who drives new business acquisition and nurtures long\-term strategic growth within a defined geographic territory. Beyond classic quota ownership, the growth leader functions as a leader, responsible for mapping the market, building a partner ecosystem, and positioning Metafusion's Vision AI portfolio (Metavisio, Metatraffic, PixelFACE etc) as the intelligence layer of choice across Critical Infra, PSUs, Smart City, Safe City, and Government \& Enterprise verticals.
 



  





 This role requires a commercially assertive, consultatively strong professional who can operate at both the CXO boardroom and the technical evaluation table — owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Revenue Ownership \& Quota Attainment** 



* Own and exceed the assigned annual revenue quota for the territory per AOP targets.
* Drive end\-to\-end deal closure for Metafusion's Video AI and Vision AI product suite across assigned accounts and geographies.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline coverage at all times, qualifying and progressing opportunities through CRM.
* Deliver accurate sales forecasts of committed numbers on a quarterly basis.



  





**B. Territory Planning \& Market Development** 



* Build and execute a structured Territory Business Plan (TBP) each quarter aligned to AOP priorities.
* Identify high\-potential verticals, critical infra, government bodies \& Enterprises (Police, Smart City, Safe City, ICCC, Traffic, Large Enterprises), PSUs, and other accounts within the territory.
* Map competitive landscape and develop counter\-positioning strategies.
* Track government tenders and proactively position Metafusion in the pre\-tendering stage.
* Maintain a living territory account map: whitespace, installed base, renewal pipeline, and upsell opportunities.



  





**C. Channel Partner \& SI Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, onboard, and enable active channel partners / System Integrators (SIs) within the territory.
* Conduct quarterly partner business reviews, co\-selling, and joint GTM activities.
* Ensure partner pipeline is logged in CRM; manage deal registration and conflict resolution.
* Train partners on Metafusion's product portfolio, solution USPs, and competitive differentiation.



  





**D. Solution Selling \& Pre\-Sales Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Pre\-Sales / Solution Engineers to craft solution architectures, BoQs, and demos tailored to customer needs.
* Lead discovery conversations and translate customer pain points into compelling Metafusion use cases.
* Support RFP / RFI responses for government and enterprise bids, ensuring compliance, differentiation, and on\-time submission.
* Conduct technical evaluation workshops, PoC planning, and site assessment visits alongside Pre\-Sales.



  





**E. CXO Engagement \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Build trusted advisor relationships with C\-level and senior decision\-makers at target accounts \& verticals.
* Coordinate with delivery and customer success teams’ post\-sale to ensure smooth implementation and account expansion.



  





**F. CRM Discipline \& Sales Reporting** 



* Maintain 100% CRM hygiene — all opportunities, activities, contacts, and deal stages updated weekly.
* Submit weekly pipeline reports and monthly territory reviews.
* Participate in appraisal cycles with documented evidence against KRA/KPI framework.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education** 



* B.E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management preferred (not mandatory for proven performers).



  





**Experience** 



* 7–8 years of B2B sales experience with at least 3 years in technology / SaaS / Video Surveillance / AI solutions.
* Demonstrated track record of quota achievement.
* Experience selling to Critical Infra, Government (Smart City, Traffic, Safe City), PSUs, or Enterprise accounts is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to tender\-driven procurement processes is a significant advantage.
* Prior experience managing channel partners / SIs in a technology sales context.



  





**Domain Knowledge** 



* Working familiarity with Video Management Systems (VMS), AI Video Analytics, ANPR/LPR, Facial Recognition, or Surveillance infrastructure.
* Awareness of Enterprise Safe City / ICCC / Smart Traffic deployments in the Indian market.
* Understanding of procurement cycles, DPR preparation, and solution architecture basics.



  





**WHY METAFUSION?** 




  




* Work at the intersection of AI, Video Intelligence, and Smart Infrastructure — one of India's fastest\-growing technology domains.
* Opportunity to be a founding GTM team member — shape market strategy, not just execute it.
* Uncapped earning potential.
* Direct access to leadership — flat hierarchy, fast decisions, and merit\-driven career progression.
* Comprehensive product portfolio across Smart City, Traffic Management, Surveillance, and Enterprise AI verticals.



  





**Positions open for territories of Delhi/NCR, North, East \& West Regions.** 




  





**Send your profile on hr@metafusion.ai**

title: Principal Customer Application Engineer
description:
The
 **Senior Customer Application Support Engineer (CAS)** 
 will provide advanced technical leadership for power conversion, motor control, and energy management solutions across key customer accounts in India. This role combines deep technical expertise with hands‑on customer engagement to support product design‑in, optimize system performance, and enable successful mass production deployments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of power electronics, motor control algorithms, embedded systems, and real‑world application tuning/debugging — along with the ability to engage directly with customers, field teams, and global R\&D.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Technical Support \& Design\-In
* Lead technical ownership for customer design\-in activities in power conversion and motor control applications.
* Support customers through the full lifecycle: architecture definition → design → validation → optimization → production.
* Provide troubleshooting, debugging, and optimization support on hardware, firmware, and control loops.
* Conduct design reviews to ensure robustness, efficiency, and thermal compliance.
* Power Conversion Expertise
* Guide customers on power topologies such as:
+ AC‑DC, DC‑DC, on\-board chargers, DCDC converters
+ Inverters, SMPS, PFC, DAB, LL resonant topologies

* Support system modeling, efficiency tuning, EMI/EMC compliance, thermal optimization, and protection schemes.
* Recommend appropriate power devices (MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC/GaN) and gate‑driver strategies.
* Motor Control Expertise
* Support motor control for BLDC, PMSM, induction motors and SRM use cases.
* Configure and tune FOC (Field\-Oriented Control), sensorless control, and advanced control loops.
* Work with MCU/MPU/NPU\-based motor control platforms for EV traction, robotics, whitegoods, industrial drives, HVAC, and mobility solutions.
* Technical Documentation \& Collateral Development
* Develop application notes, schematics, design guidelines, reference designs, and customer kits.
* Create training material and deliver workshops to customers, channel partners, and internal teams.
* Provide technical insights to improve documentation and support materials.
* Collaboration with Global Engineering Teams
* Act as the technical bridge between India customers and global R\&D / product teams.
* Provide field feedback for product roadmap, feature improvements, and bug resolution.
* Support evaluation platform creation, firmware releases, and silicon validation.
* Pre‑Sales \& Post‑Sales Technical Enablement
* Partner with Business Development and Sales teams to influence early architecture decisions.
* Present product advantages, benchmarks, competitive comparisons, and solution differentiation.
* Support PoCs, prototypes, and performance evaluations at customer sites.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Technical Requirements (Must‑Have)**
* 7–12\+ years of experience in power electronics, motor control, or applications engineering.
* Strong expertise in:
+ Power supplies, converters, inverters, and high‑voltage design
+ BLDC/PMSM motor control, FOC, PWM strategies, gate drive tuning
+ MCU/MPU/dSPIC/ARM Cortex microcontrollers for real\-time control
+ Power semiconductor devices (MOSFET, IGBT, SiC/GaN)

* Hands‑on experience with:
+ Oscilloscopes, power analyzers, current probes
+ Motor tuning platforms, simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, PSIM, LTspice)
+ Hardware bring‑up, debugging, EMI/EMC analysis


**Soft Skills**
* Strong customer‑facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work across cross‑functional teams and manage multiple projects.
* Problem\-solving mindset with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts for non‑technical stakeholders.


**Education**
* B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electronics, or related fields.


 Additional certifications in power electronics or motor control are a plus
   

  

**Success Metrics**
* Number of successful design‑ins and production wins.
* Customer satisfaction scores and feedback.
* Timeliness and quality of technical support and issue resolution.
* Reference designs, application notes, and training materials delivered.
* Contribution to product roadmap and field insights.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

* Product

* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership

* Revenue

title: Solution Engineer, Manager
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 You will become a member of the border management’s architecture team and provide consulting services to the product and customer delivery teams, helping with guidance throughout the design and development process of our business opportunities. You will also be designing and developing solution architectures to meet business requirements and provide value for money. The ability to be hands\-on and support product and project delivery and transition work is important in addition to an architecture and design role.
   

  

 As Solution Engineer Manager you will have the opportunity to be involved in the end\-to\-end solution process at both the sales and delivery stages of the customer relationship, translating customer aims and requirements into a new solution with agreement through our governance processes.
   

  

 Reporting to the Solution Engineer Director at SITA At Borders, you will be part of a team challenging the status quo, designing solutions that employ strong architecture frameworks and using technologies such as AI/Machine Learning, Biometrics Matching and Identity Management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As a Manager, Customer Solution Engineering, you will work closely with other members of the Engineering team, supporting, and contributing to all aspects of the role, including:
   

  

* Design/coordinate development of standard and complex solutions which may involve multiple parties both internally and externally including the selection of 3rd party vendors to meet customer requirements. Solutions may support government, border management, immigration, customs, or national security customers operating in mission\-critical environments.
* Support account teams or competency centers during the pre\-contract phases (qualification proposals and contract) with technical designs and advice. Including support for high\-value, long\-cycle government procurement processes such as RFIs, RFPs, and competitive dialogue.
* Provide the technical qualification and own the technical parts of proposals submitted to customers through knowledge of current new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios. Including ownership of technical risk, compliance, and feasibility for large\-scale government and border programs.
* Promote SITA by furnishing customers with comprehensive up\-to\-date information on current products, product enhancements and new solutions through customer meetings and workshops. Leading technical workshops with senior government and operational stakeholders.
* Facilitate designs to be efficiently implemented Right the First Time (RFT) and supported operationally. Ensuring solutions are designed for operability, maintainability, and 24/7 support.
* Collaborate with colleague to gain and share ideas and opportunities. Collaborating across sales, delivery, security, and operations teams.
* Account for designing solutions for large or complex programs in accordance with business strategies, standards, and processes. Designing national\-scale systems with high availability, resilience, and performance requirements.
* Ensure designs in compliance with Industry standards and architectural plans. Ensuring compliance with international, aviation, and border standards such as ICAO, IATA and ISO.
* Lead and coordinate with subject matter experts (SMEs) involved with solution design and subsequent implementation. Acting as solution authority coordinating products, security, infrastructure, and integration SMEs.
* Work with the architects, development, and products engineering teams within the SITA Government business unit to products successful customer designs. Ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, architectural principles, and security frameworks.
* Assess the viability and value of new technologies and patterns, working to ensure we align with the business’s technical aims for scalability and growth. Evaluating emerging technologies in biometrics, identity management, secure integration, and data platforms.
* Understanding of system security. Designing secure\-by\-design solutions including IAM, encryption, network security, and compliance with government security and assurance frameworks.


**Qualifications**
 ABOUT YOUR SKILLS
   

  

* 6–8 years of experience in Information Technology, Telecom Industry or Air Transport Industry technology in a technical pre\-sales role or lead architect role. Experience working with government or public\-sector customers is highly desirable.
* BS level Technical Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering Computer Technologies.
* Ability to provide technical system solutions, determine overall design direction and provide hardware recommendations for complex technical issues. Including solutions operating in mission\-critical and high\-availability environments.
* Experienced in designing, integrating, and managing software solutions. Including large\-scale, multi\-system integrations and legacy interoperability.
* Have a background in working in a systems integration industry. Including delivery of systems\-of\-systems in complex stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in producing, communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions. Including high\-level and detailed design documentation (HLD/LLD) for regulated environments.
* Pre\-Sales Business and or Commercial experience is a plus. Including support to government tenders and commercial negotiations.
* Have a very strong solutions \& application architecture background, with a very good understanding how it impacts the other IT disciplines.
* A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology.
* An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act and GDPR. Including handling of biometric and highly sensitive personal data.
* Ability to demonstrate an understanding of the end\-to\-end solution.
* Deliver and ensure quality assurance against the design during the project phases. Including participation in design governance, reviews, and acceptance milestones.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences. Including engagement with senior government and executive stakeholders.
* Problem\-solving and good analytical skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Flexibility and adaptability.
* Team Player and self starter.


 NICE\-TO\-HAVE
   

  

* Experience in Aviation and borders industry. Including border management, immigration, customs, or law enforcement solutions.
* TOGAF certificate
* ITIL
* Experience with biometric technologies, cloud or hybrid architectures, international border standards, or security certifications.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡

 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰

 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎

 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀

 Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
   

  

 🙌

 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi**

**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
