description:
**Company:DeutscheTelekomDigitalLabs,Gurgaon**
 Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the behind\-the\-scenes powerhouse that fuels Deutsche Telekom’s passion \& commitment to cutting edge innovation \& out of the world customer experience.Wecreatecompellingdigitalpropositionsfortheworlds’largestTelekomgiantby building scalable and agile platforms to provide the best of digital experience to Deutsche Telekom customers across Europe.

 Youaskwhat’sinitforyou?Wesay,
   

  

* An opportunity to build digital products from scratch (literally from scratch!) for one of theleadingEuropeantelecoms(DeutscheTelekom)usinglatesttechnologies\&oncloud native platforms.
* Enhanced customer experience, convergence, and increased business productivity, continuouslyinvestingintoentrepreneurialvaluecreationprojectstobuildagilityand cross functional teams in order to steer innovative business models.


 Weareagileandfocusedontheoverallmakeupoftheteam.Webelievethatwiththeright team \- anything is possible. If you’re looking for an environment that’s fun and friendly but incrediblyfast\-paced;aplacewherewemeasurethetimebetweenreleasesindays;aplace where our focus begins and ends at the consumer \- join us!
   

  

 Role:Engineering Manager — Forward Deployed
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 OneBot deflects contact\-center volume for Deutsche Telekom across nine European markets. The platform strategy has moved from building a single bot we own to running the harness that routes across best\-of\-breed dialog engines — Parloa, ElevenLabs, Wonderful, Decagon and OneBot — with a shared context layer beneath.
   

  

 That split creates two genuinely different engineering jobs. Three PODs build reusable capability: the Router, the Harness capabilities, and the Stability and Acceleration platform. This POD does not build capability. It owns the delivery of use cases inside the NatCos — getting engines live market by market, integrating APIs from systems we do not control, and clearing the business, security and procurement barriers that stand between a working capability and a customer being served by it.
   

  

 Historically that work was squeezed between platform priorities and NatCo deadlines, with no single owner. The result was repeated: multiple divergent integration patterns with vendors, per\-country workarounds, and platform features paused mid\-build. This role exists to own the outcome — and to own it without fragmenting the platform.
   

  

**Delivery Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of NatCo use cases: from requirement through integration, security clearance, launch and post\-launch quality.
* Hold the launch date. Sequence work across your squads, surface dependencies on the capability PODs early, and escalate rather than absorb.
* Own post\-launch outcomes, not just go\-live — deflection, containment and customer experience are yours after the switch is flipped.


**Partners and vendors**
* Run technology and dialog\-engine partners as delivery partners: onboarding under IT guidelines with defined entry and exit criteria, integration milestones, and SLAs that hold.
* Be the single technical point of contact partners escalate to, and the person who holds them to commitments.


**Stakeholders, security and compliance**
* Work with NatCo business owners, product, PSA, security, privacy and procurement to clear the non\-engineering blockers that stall AI launches.
* Drive security and privacy review to a decision — anticipate what reviewers will ask and bring it before they ask.


**People and team**
* Line\-manage the Forward Deployed Engineers and squad leads: hiring, growth, performance, and building the FDE career path.
* Build a team that is credible in front of a customer and in a code review — deploy engineers into markets without losing their engineering depth.


**Platform discipline**
* Push fixes and patterns discovered in the field back upstream into the owning capability POD, rather than solving them locally.
* Say no to the fast local workaround. Protecting one implementation across nine markets is part of the job, not a constraint on it.


**Must\-have Skills And Experience**
* Experience. 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers with hiring and performance ownership.
* Hands\-on integration depth. You have personally shipped production integrations against enterprise APIs — REST and event\-driven — in Java, Python or equivalent. You can read the code your team writes and review a design.
* Customer\-facing delivery. You have owned delivery in front of a customer, a partner or an internal business unit, where the commitment was yours and the systems were not.
* Vendor management. Onboarding and managing technology partners: commercial and technical entry criteria, integration milestones, SLA enforcement, and a defined exit.
* Security and compliance fluency. You have taken a product through enterprise security, privacy and procurement review — PSA, DPIA, pen\-test remediation or the equivalent — and know how to shorten it.
* Multi\-market rollout. Rolling the same platform into multiple markets, tenants or customers, and holding one implementation while doing it.
* AI systems literacy. Working knowledge of how modern LLM applications are built and operated: prompts and operating procedures, tool calling and MCP, RAG, evaluation, and voice pipelines including STT, TTS, endpointing and barge\-in. Enough to hold an architectural line in a partner conversation — you are not expected to invent the architecture.
* Ways of working. Comfortable operating across time zones with European stakeholders, with regular travel to markets.


**Nice To Have**
* Telecommunications or contact\-center domain experience — IVR, CCaaS, routing, agent desktop.
* A forward\-deployed or solutions\-engineering background, where engineers are embedded in the customer's environment to deliver an outcome.


**What This Role Is Not**
**Not a programme or project manager.** 
 The POD has a dedicated TPM who owns programme mechanics, cross\-POD dependencies and reporting. This role owns the engineering team and the outcome.
   

  

**Not an individual\-contributor architect.** 
 Engineers report to you. People leadership is a first\-class part of the job, not an overhead on it.

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
 TartanHQ builds
 **HyperSync** 
 (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and
 **HyperVerify** 
 (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).
   

  

 We're hiring three
 **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** 
 to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.
   

  

 This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:
   

  

* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


 You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.
   

  

**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
- Deal Cycle Turnaround: Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination

- InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround: Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt

 Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time: \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/EngineeringClient Response Time: \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
 - Internal SLA Adherence: 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines

- Active Relationships Managed: Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads

- Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)
* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold
* Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)
* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients
* Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)
* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders
* Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)
* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required


**What We Look For**
* Client\-first mindset: Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* Ownership mentality: Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* Professional \& sincere: Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* Coordination discipline: Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* Composure under pressure: Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* Growth mindset: This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

 This is a senior, technical Pre\-Tendering, Costing \& Estimation role strictly for Civil Engineers with hands\-on Railway and Metro tendering experience. This is not a Business Development, Marketing, Sales, or post\-award Contracts/Execution role. Candidates without direct, verifiable experience in Railway/Metro civil pre\-tender costing and estimation will not be shortlisted.  \- Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering (Mandatory). M.Tech in Civil Engineering.

 \- Documentation: Candidates must be able to produce original mark sheets and certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post\-Graduation) and relevant experience proof at the time of interview.

 Dilip Buildcon Limited is hiring for its Railways \& Metro Pre\-Tendering, Costing \& Estimation team in New Delhi.  Hands\-on experience in Railway construction tender estimation and proposal preparation, including EPC/BOQ and Composite tenders, Viaducts, Bridges, Tunnels, Track/BLT (Ballastless Track) and Station Building tenders, at a senior/leadership level.
 



  





**Key Skills and Proficiency Required:** 




 Underground Metro projects, Elevated Viaduct projects, Station and Tunnel projects, Railway Composite works, Technical and Commercial Proposal preparation, Bidding Strategy, Tender Finalization, Quantity and Cost Estimation, Site Surveys, Rate Analysis, Railway Pre\-Tendering processes.

 Conventional Railways, Metro Rail Corporations, Semi High Speed Rail

title: Senior Associate, Tech M&A - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
**Our DTS Team Provides Following Services To Clients**
* Data \& Applied Intelligence \- Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting\-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision\-making and transform businesses.
* Product and Innovation \- Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage.
* Technology M\&A and Strategy \- Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M\&A, integrations and carve\-outs.
* Technology Transformation \- A\&M helps clients create a scalable, cost\-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.


**How You Will Contribute**
 As a SA in the Technology M\&A team, you will lead and drive the technical evaluation, planning, and execution of IT\-focused workstreams across the M\&A lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include IT due diligence, integration planning, and separation (carve\-out) execution. You will work closely with clients (corporate or private equity), cross\-functional deal teams, and technical stakeholders to identify technology risks and value levers, recommend strategies, and deliver roadmaps for tech integration or separation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Pre\-Deal / Due Diligence**
* Lead technology due diligence for buy\-side and sell\-side engagements: assess the target’s IT organization, applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and technology maturity.
* Identify and evaluate technology risks, technical debt, hidden costs, and integration complexity.
* Develop detailed deliverables: data request lists, interview guides, agendas, architecture assessments, cost models, synergies, transition service agreement (TSA) schedules, integration or separation roadmaps.
* Estimate IT cost transformation opportunities, synergies, and post\-deal investments.
* Synthesize and present findings to executive stakeholders (both technical and business), providing actionable recommendations.
* Support the proposal process: define scope, pricing, and resource plans for prospective clients. Post\-Deal / Integration \& Separation


**Lead post\-merger IT integration or carve\-out separation programs**
* For carve\-outs, define and manage the “IT Separation Management Office”; for integrations, drive the “IT Integration Management Office” (IMO).
* Define and design the target IT operating model, including organizational structure, governance, processes, and systems alignment.
* Develop and maintain program governance artifacts: project plan, status dashboards, risk \& issue logs, resource plans.
* Lead initiative to disentangle and rationalize systems, cloud infrastructure, vendor contracts, and service delivery (outsourcing/offshoring) where relevant.
* Ensure smooth “Day 1” readiness: design day\-zero run\-rates, TSA (if any), and operating model handover.
* Mentor junior team members, providing technical and project leadership, knowledge sharing, and quality control of deliverables.


**Client Engagement \& Business Development**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to client C\-level and senior stakeholders on technology risks, dependencies, and opportunities in M\&A.
* Contribute to business development efforts — help shape proposals, estimate effort, define offering differentiators, and identify cross\-sell opportunities.
* Stay up to date with trends in M\&A technology (cloud, data center, cyber, SaaS) and integrate best practices into client engagements.


**Qualifications**
* 3\-7 years of experience in IT / technology consulting, transaction advisory, or consulting with significant exposure to M\&A.
* Deep experience in IT due diligence (pre\-deal) and post\-deal integration or separation. (Big 4 or strategy consulting preferred.)
* Proven track record of managing cross\-functional teams on complex M\&A technology engagements.
* Good understanding of enterprise applications (on\-prem, cloud), infrastructure (data centers, cloud), data architecture, and cybersecurity.
* Familiar with vendor management, outsourcing/offshoring, and IT operating models.
* Experience with integration patterns, carve\-out strategies, TSA design, and technology road mapping.
* Ability to build and analyze cost models, synergy estimates, and IT financial projections.
* Experience in benchmarking, risk quantification, and value\-creation analysis.
* Strong program management capabilities: planning, governance, risk management.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), able to interact with senior stakeholders (technical and business)
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. (MBA or advanced degree is a plus.)


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

**How will you grow and be supported?**
 At A\&M, we know our people drive our growth, and we're focused on providing an employee experience that supports professional and personal development. We provide our team with a robust performance development process which encourages continuous learning and development that rewards you for your contributions. We have the best technical and formalized on\-the\-job training and offer endless opportunities for professionals to acquire new skills. We also prioritize your well\-being and provide personal tools and resources to support you through your personal journey.

title: Senior Associate, Microsoft Enterprise Solutions Engineer, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Microsoft 365 Governance team is responsible for implementing, maturing, and maintaining the firm’s Microsoft 365 governance framework across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, M365 Groups, Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, and other integrated governance tools. The team manages the full lifecycle of governance — from establishing new processes and policies to enhancing and maturing existing controls — ensuring the Microsoft 365 environment remains secure, compliant, and scalable. The team also supports platform change management initiatives, drives structured governance programs, and provides Level 3 (L3\) support for complex governance and platform escalations.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 As a Microsoft Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Governance Creation, Implementation \& Maturation
* Contribute to the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of governance processes and controls
* Build, implement, and iterate automated workflows and governance controls using AvePoint.
* Implement and evolve Microsoft Purview solutions (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, insider risk, data lifecycle).
* Create and maintain governance documentation, knowledge base articles, guides, training materials, and processes.
* Contribute to the governance roadmap by identifying gaps, proposing new controls, and driving improvements that mature the overall governance posture.
* 2 Governance Operations, BAU \& L3 Support
* Provide L3\-level support for complex governance solutions \& escalations.
* Troubleshoot advanced issues across SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Purview, AvePoint, and Power Platform.
* Perform assessments and implement improvements that mature overall workspace quality and reduce sprawl.
* Operate within Microsoft 365 admin centers (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, Entra, Purview) to carry out governance actions.
* Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Communicate governance updates, implementations, and maturity improvements.
* Support rollout and adoption of new governance enhancements (AvePoint workflows, Purview controls, admin center changes).
* Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistent governance implementation across regions.
* Act as an escalation point for governance exceptions, policy interpretations, and access\-related issues. Reporting, Analysis \& Insights
* Build, maintain and monitor dashboards tracking governance metrics, lifecycle status, maturity progress, risk areas, and sprawl reduction.
* Analyze Excel/Power BI/AvePoint/Purview data to generate insights that drive governance improvements.
* Provide concise, actionable recommendations and summaries for leadership decision\-making.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft 365 governance and collaboration platforms.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, Entra ID, and related permissions and security concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing and maturing Microsoft Purview policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, and sensitivity labeling.
* Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and continuously enhance governance processes, frameworks, and documentation.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 migration initiatives.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for governance implementation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Proven experience providing Level 3 (L3\) operational support for complex platform and governance\-related issues.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data\-driven analysis.
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
